title: Claude Wrote It. Git Hooks Kept It Honest.
kicker: Building a generic AI agent for HATEOAS APIs
html:
Claude Wrote It. Git Hooks Kept It Honest.

How I used Claude and git hooks together to build a generic AI agent for HATEOAS APIs.

Borrowed Built for
say: Have you ever asked an AI agent to do the same thing twice and gotten two different answers? I have. This talk is about how I stopped that from happening, in two places at once. First, in the code: Claude wrote nearly all of it, mostly from my dictation through Claude Code's /remote-control, and git hooks kept it honest, one behavior at a time. Second, in what the code is: ARTIE, a generic agent for hypermedia APIs, the kind Roy Fielding described, where every answer tells you what you can do next. And at the end, a release that runs across five services, every one of them speaking the same media type. Let's start with the two ideas I borrowed.
